#!/bin/bash

#  inside a quoted context - sanitize() (shlex.quote) wraps

KIND=services

SEL_NAMESPACE=boutique
SEL_LABELS=
SEL_FIELDS=

[ "$SEL_NAMESPACE" = "None" ] && SEL_NAMESPACE=""
[ "$SEL_LABELS" = "None" ] && SEL_LABELS=""
[ "$SEL_FIELDS" = "None" ] && SEL_FIELDS=""

# Note: use $'\n' syntax instead of '\n' because Jinja2 interprets \n as literal newlines
JQ_FILTER='.items[] | {name: .metadata.name, ports: .spec.ports, selector: .spec.selector, clusterIP: .spec.clusterIP}'
JQ_FILTER=$(printf '%s' "$JQ_FILTER" | tr $'\n\r' '  ')

err_file=$(mktemp)
PROCESSED=0
NOTES='[]'
SCOPE='null'

add_note() {
  NOTES=$(jq -c --arg note "$1" '. + [$note]' <<< "$NOTES")
}

uri_encode() {
  jq -rn --arg v "$1" '$v|@uri'
}

fail() {
  err_content=$(cat "$err_file" 2>/dev/null)
  rm -f "$err_file"
  jq -n --arg stderr "$1 $err_content" --argjson total "$PROCESSED" --argjson notes "$NOTES" --argjson scope "$SCOPE" \
    '{total_items_processed: $total, matches_found: 0, results: [], stderr: $stderr, scope: $scope, notes: $notes}'
  exit 0

# The namespace becomes part of the raw API path, so anything other than a valid
# namespace name (e.g. 'default/services/x:80/proxy/?') could reach other API endpoints

  fail "Invalid namespace '${SEL_NAMESPACE}': must be a Kubernetes namespace name (lowercase letters, digits and '-')."
fi

# Match the resource name (first column) as an EXACT string, not a
# grep regex - otherwise a kind like '.*' or 'a|b' would match the
# wrong resource.
CANDIDATES=$(kubectl api-resources --no-headers 2>>"$err_file" | awk -v kind="$KIND" '$1 == kind')

# plural (e.g. Calico's crd.projectcalico.org networkpolicies) can be listed
# before networking.k8s.io. Pick what `kubectl get` picks: the core group,
# then the first group in server discovery order (/apis).

    add_note "Several API groups serve '${KIND}' and server discovery (/apis) failed, so the first group listed by kubectl api-resources was used."

  for group in $API_GROUPS; do
    match=$(printf '%s\n' "$CANDIDATES" | grep -F " $group/" | head -1)
    if [ -n "$match" ]; then
      API_INFO="$match"
      break
    fi

  fail "Unable to find resource kind '${KIND}'."
fi

  NAMESPACED=true
  PREFIX=$(echo "$API_INFO" | sed 's/ true .*//')
elif [[ "$API_INFO" == *" false "* ]]; then
  NAMESPACED=false
  PREFIX=$(echo "$API_INFO" | sed 's/ false .*//')
else
  fail "Could not parse API info for '${KIND}'."

done

  API_VERSION="${PREFIX_FIELDS[$((FIELD_COUNT - 1))]}"
else
  API_VERSION=""

  fail "Unable to parse API info for resource kind '${KIND}'."

# cluster-scoped kinds ignore the namespace (as kubectl does)

fi

  SELECTOR_QUERY="${SELECTOR_QUERY}&labelSelector=$(uri_encode "$SEL_LABELS")"
fi
if [ -n "$SEL_FIELDS" ]; then
  SELECTOR_QUERY="${SELECTOR_QUERY}&fieldSelector=$(uri_encode "$SEL_FIELDS")"
fi

SCOPE=$(jq -nc --arg resource "$RESOURCE_NAME" --arg api_version "$API_VERSION" \
  --arg namespace "$SEL_NAMESPACE" --arg labels "$SEL_LABELS" --arg fields "$SEL_FIELDS" \
  '{resource: $resource, api_version: $api_version,
    namespace: (if $namespace == "" then null else $namespace end),
    label_selector: (if $labels == "" then null else $labels end),
    field_selector: (if $fields == "" then null else $fields end)}')

# Process resources in chunks using API pagination
LIMIT=500
CONTINUE=""
TOTAL_MATCHES=0
ALL_MATCHES=""

while true; do
  QUERY="${API_PATH}?limit=${LIMIT}${SELECTOR_QUERY}"

        ALL_MATCHES="$ALL_MATCHES"$'\n'"$MATCHES"

      MATCH_COUNT=$(echo "$MATCHES" | grep -c . || true)
      TOTAL_MATCHES=$((TOTAL_MATCHES + MATCH_COUNT))

  fi

  --argjson matches_found "$TOTAL_MATCHES" \
  --arg stderr "$err_content" \
  --argjson scope "$SCOPE" \
  --argjson notes "$NOTES" \
  '{total_items_processed: $total_items_processed, matches_found: $matches_found, results: ., stderr: (if $stderr == "" then null else $stderr end), scope: $scope, notes: $notes}'

#!/bin/bash
# SECURITY: assign sanitized params to shell variables (unquoted slot),
# then reference them only as "$VAR" - never interpolate 
# inside a quoted context. See kubernetes_jq_query for the rationale.
KIND=pods
CUSTOM_COLUMNS='NAME:.metadata.name,READY:.status.containerStatuses[*].ready,NODE:.spec.nodeName,IP:.status.podIP,START:.status.startTime,PHASE:.status.phase'
# 'namespace' is also a Jinja global (namespace()), so it is defined even when omitted
SEL_NAMESPACE=boutique
SEL_LABELS=
SEL_FIELDS=
FILTER_PATTERN=
# Strict tool calls send null for unset optional params, which renders as 'None'
[ "$SEL_NAMESPACE" = "None" ] && SEL_NAMESPACE=""
[ "$SEL_LABELS" = "None" ] && SEL_LABELS=""
[ "$SEL_FIELDS" = "None" ] && SEL_FIELDS=""
[ "$FILTER_PATTERN" = "None" ] && FILTER_PATTERN=""

# kubectl ignores -n for cluster-scoped kinds; say so instead of reporting a namespace that wasn't applied
NOTES='[]'
if [ -n "$SEL_NAMESPACE" ]; then
  is_kind() { awk -v kind="$KIND" '$1 == kind || index($1, kind ".") == 1 {found = 1} END {exit !found}'; }
  if kubectl api-resources --namespaced=false -o name 2>/dev/null | is_kind \
    && ! kubectl api-resources --namespaced=true -o name 2>/dev/null | is_kind; then
    NOTES=$(jq -nc --arg note "namespace '${SEL_NAMESPACE}' ignored: ${KIND} is cluster-scoped." '[$note]')
    SEL_NAMESPACE=""
  fi
fi

SCOPE_ARGS=()
if [ -n "$SEL_NAMESPACE" ]; then
  SCOPE_ARGS+=(-n "$SEL_NAMESPACE")
else
  SCOPE_ARGS+=(--all-namespaces)
fi
if [ -n "$SEL_LABELS" ]; then
  SCOPE_ARGS+=(-l "$SEL_LABELS")
fi
if [ -n "$SEL_FIELDS" ]; then
  SCOPE_ARGS+=(--field-selector "$SEL_FIELDS")
fi

err_file=$(mktemp)
output=$(kubectl get "$KIND" "${SCOPE_ARGS[@]}" -o custom-columns="$CUSTOM_COLUMNS" 2>"$err_file")
kubectl_exit=$?
err_content=$(cat "$err_file" 2>/dev/null)
rm -f "$err_file"

SCOPE='null'
if command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
  SCOPE=$(jq -nc --arg namespace "$SEL_NAMESPACE" --arg labels "$SEL_LABELS" --arg fields "$SEL_FIELDS" \
    '{namespace: (if $namespace == "" then null else $namespace end),
      label_selector: (if $labels == "" then null else $labels end),
      field_selector: (if $fields == "" then null else $fields end)}')
fi

if [ $kubectl_exit -ne 0 ] || [ -z "$output" ]; then
  if command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
    jq -n --arg stderr "$err_content" --argjson scope "$SCOPE" --argjson notes "$NOTES" \
      '{count: 0, header: null, rows: [], stderr: $stderr, scope: $scope, notes: $notes}'
  else
    echo "=== STDERR ==="
    echo "$err_content"
    echo "=== ROWS ==="
    echo "=== COUNT ==="
    echo 0
  fi
  exit 0
fi

# Split header and data rows
header=$(echo "$output" | head -1)
if [ -n "$FILTER_PATTERN" ]; then
  data=$(echo "$output" | tail -n +2 | grep -E -- "$FILTER_PATTERN" || true)
else
  data=$(echo "$output" | tail -n +2)
fi

if command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
  if [ -n "$data" ]; then
    count=$(echo "$data" | wc -l)
  else
    count=0
  fi
  # Rows go through stdin, not --argjson, so large tables don't hit "Argument list too long"
  printf '%s' "$data" | jq -R . | jq -s \
    --argjson count "$count" \
    --arg header "$header" \
    --arg stderr "$err_content" \
    --argjson scope "$SCOPE" \
    --argjson notes "$NOTES" \
    '{count: $count, header: $header, rows: ., stderr: (if $stderr == "" then null else $stderr end), scope: $scope, notes: $notes}'
else
  echo "=== STDERR ==="
  echo "$err_content"
  echo "=== HEADER ==="
  echo "$header"
  echo "=== ROWS ==="
  echo "$data"
  echo "=== COUNT ==="
  if [ -n "$data" ]; then echo "$data" | wc -l; else echo 0; fi
fi

# assignment slot, then reference them only as "$VAR". Never interpolate
#  inside a quoted context - sanitize() (shlex.quote) wraps
# dangerous values in single quotes, which are literal (and command
# substitution stays active) inside a double-quoted or single-quoted slot.
KIND=deployments
# 'namespace' is also a Jinja global (namespace()), so it is defined even when omitted
SEL_NAMESPACE=boutique
SEL_LABELS=
SEL_FIELDS=
# Strict tool calls send null for unset optional params, which renders as 'None'
[ "$SEL_NAMESPACE" = "None" ] && SEL_NAMESPACE=""
[ "$SEL_LABELS" = "None" ] && SEL_LABELS=""
[ "$SEL_FIELDS" = "None" ] && SEL_FIELDS=""

# Collapse multi-line jq expressions (LLMs sometimes write multi-line jq)
# Note: use $'\n' syntax instead of '\n' because Jinja2 interprets \n as literal newlines
JQ_FILTER='.items[] | {name: .metadata.name, selector: .spec.selector, template: .spec.template}'
JQ_FILTER=$(printf '%s' "$JQ_FILTER" | tr $'\n\r' '  ')

err_file=$(mktemp)
PROCESSED=0
NOTES='[]'
SCOPE='null'

add_note() {
  NOTES=$(jq -c --arg note "$1" '. + [$note]' <<< "$NOTES")
}

uri_encode() {
  jq -rn --arg v "$1" '$v|@uri'
}

fail() {
  err_content=$(cat "$err_file" 2>/dev/null)
  rm -f "$err_file"
  jq -n --arg stderr "$1 $err_content" --argjson total "$PROCESSED" --argjson notes "$NOTES" --argjson scope "$SCOPE" \
    '{total_items_processed: $total, matches_found: 0, results: [], stderr: $stderr, scope: $scope, notes: $notes}'
  exit 0
}

# The namespace becomes part of the raw API path, so anything other than a valid
# namespace name (e.g. 'default/services/x:80/proxy/?') could reach other API endpoints
if [ -n "$SEL_NAMESPACE" ] && ! [[ "$SEL_NAMESPACE" =~ ^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$ ]]; then
  fail "Invalid namespace '${SEL_NAMESPACE}': must be a Kubernetes namespace name (lowercase letters, digits and '-')."
fi

# Get the API path for the resource kind using kubectl
# Match the resource name (first column) as an EXACT string, not a
# grep regex - otherwise a kind like '.*' or 'a|b' would match the
# wrong resource.
CANDIDATES=$(kubectl api-resources --no-headers 2>>"$err_file" | awk -v kind="$KIND" '$1 == kind')
API_INFO=$(printf '%s\n' "$CANDIDATES" | head -1)
# `kubectl api-resources` sorts by group name, so a CRD reusing a built-in
# plural (e.g. Calico's crd.projectcalico.org networkpolicies) can be listed
# before networking.k8s.io. Pick what `kubectl get` picks: the core group,
# then the first group in server discovery order (/apis).
if [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$CANDIDATES" | grep -c .)" -gt 1 ] && [[ "$API_INFO" != *" v1 "* ]]; then
  API_GROUPS=$(kubectl get --raw /apis 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.groups[].name' 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -z "$API_GROUPS" ]; then
    add_note "Several API groups serve '${KIND}' and server discovery (/apis) failed, so the first group listed by kubectl api-resources was used."
  fi
  for group in $API_GROUPS; do
    match=$(printf '%s\n' "$CANDIDATES" | grep -F " $group/" | head -1)
    if [ -n "$match" ]; then
      API_INFO="$match"
      break
    fi
  done
fi

if [ -z "$API_INFO" ]; then
  fail "Unable to find resource kind '${KIND}'."
fi

# Extract NAMESPACED value
if [[ "$API_INFO" == *" true "* ]]; then
  NAMESPACED=true
  PREFIX=$(echo "$API_INFO" | sed 's/ true .*//')
elif [[ "$API_INFO" == *" false "* ]]; then
  NAMESPACED=false
  PREFIX=$(echo "$API_INFO" | sed 's/ false .*//')
else
  fail "Could not parse API info for '${KIND}'."
fi

# Trim trailing spaces from prefix and collapse internal spaces
PREFIX=$(echo "$PREFIX" | sed 's/  *$//' | sed 's/  */ /g')

IFS=' ' read -ra PREFIX_FIELDS <<< "$PREFIX"
FIELD_COUNT=0
for field in "${PREFIX_FIELDS[@]}"; do
  ((FIELD_COUNT++))
done

RESOURCE_NAME="${PREFIX_FIELDS[0]}"
if [ $FIELD_COUNT -ge 2 ]; then
  API_VERSION="${PREFIX_FIELDS[$((FIELD_COUNT - 1))]}"
else
  API_VERSION=""
fi

if [ -z "$API_VERSION" ] || [ -z "$RESOURCE_NAME" ]; then
  fail "Unable to parse API info for resource kind '${KIND}'."
fi

# Build API path: namespaced kinds can be listed within one namespace;
# cluster-scoped kinds ignore the namespace (as kubectl does)
if [[ "$API_VERSION" == "v1" ]]; then
  API_BASE="/api/v1"
else
  API_BASE="/apis/${API_VERSION}"
fi
if [ -n "$SEL_NAMESPACE" ] && [ "$NAMESPACED" = "true" ]; then
  API_PATH="${API_BASE}/namespaces/${SEL_NAMESPACE}/${RESOURCE_NAME}"
else
  if [ -n "$SEL_NAMESPACE" ]; then
    add_note "namespace '${SEL_NAMESPACE}' ignored: ${RESOURCE_NAME} is cluster-scoped."
    SEL_NAMESPACE=""
  fi
  API_PATH="${API_BASE}/${RESOURCE_NAME}"
fi

SELECTOR_QUERY=""
if [ -n "$SEL_LABELS" ]; then
  SELECTOR_QUERY="${SELECTOR_QUERY}&labelSelector=$(uri_encode "$SEL_LABELS")"
fi
if [ -n "$SEL_FIELDS" ]; then
  SELECTOR_QUERY="${SELECTOR_QUERY}&fieldSelector=$(uri_encode "$SEL_FIELDS")"
fi

SCOPE=$(jq -nc --arg resource "$RESOURCE_NAME" --arg api_version "$API_VERSION" \
  --arg namespace "$SEL_NAMESPACE" --arg labels "$SEL_LABELS" --arg fields "$SEL_FIELDS" \
  '{resource: $resource, api_version: $api_version,
    namespace: (if $namespace == "" then null else $namespace end),
    label_selector: (if $labels == "" then null else $labels end),
    field_selector: (if $fields == "" then null else $fields end)}')

# Process resources in chunks using API pagination
LIMIT=500
CONTINUE=""
TOTAL_MATCHES=0
ALL_MATCHES=""

while true; do
  QUERY="${API_PATH}?limit=${LIMIT}${SELECTOR_QUERY}"
  if [ -n "$CONTINUE" ]; then
    # continue tokens are base64 and may contain '+', '/' or '='
    QUERY="${QUERY}&continue=$(uri_encode "$CONTINUE")"
  fi

  OUTPUT=$(kubectl get --raw "$QUERY" 2>>"$err_file")
  exit_code=$?

  if [ $exit_code -ne 0 ]; then
    fail "kubectl get --raw failed for $QUERY."
  fi

  ITEMS_COUNT=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | jq '.items | length')

  MATCHES=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | jq -c "$JQ_FILTER" 2>>"$err_file")
  jq_exit=$?
  if [ $jq_exit -ne 0 ]; then
    fail "jq expression failed."
  fi

  if [ "$ITEMS_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
    if [ -n "$MATCHES" ]; then
      if [ -z "$ALL_MATCHES" ]; then
        ALL_MATCHES="$MATCHES"
      else
        ALL_MATCHES="$ALL_MATCHES"$'\n'"$MATCHES"
      fi
      MATCH_COUNT=$(echo "$MATCHES" | grep -c . || true)
      TOTAL_MATCHES=$((TOTAL_MATCHES + MATCH_COUNT))
    fi
    PROCESSED=$((PROCESSED + ITEMS_COUNT))
  fi

  CONTINUE=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | jq -r '.metadata.continue // empty')

  if [ -z "$CONTINUE" ]; then
    break
  fi
done

err_content=$(cat "$err_file" 2>/dev/null)
rm -f "$err_file"

# Output results as a JSON object with metadata. Results go through stdin, not --argjson:
# Linux caps a single argument at 128KB, so larger results failed with "Argument list too long".
printf '%s\n' "$ALL_MATCHES" | jq -s \
  --argjson total_items_processed "$PROCESSED" \
  --argjson matches_found "$TOTAL_MATCHES" \
  --arg stderr "$err_content" \
  --argjson scope "$SCOPE" \
  --argjson notes "$NOTES" \
  '{total_items_processed: $total_items_processed, matches_found: $matches_found, results: ., stderr: (if $stderr == "" then null else $stderr end), scope: $scope, notes: $notes}'

    echo "=== ROWS ==="
    echo "=== COUNT ==="

    fi
  done

fi

  NAMESPACED=true

  NAMESPACED=false
  PREFIX=$(echo "$API_INFO" | sed 's/ false .*//')

  fail "Could not parse API info for '${KIND}'."

  --argjson notes "$NOTES" \

## 本轮新查到的证据（第 3 轮）

**1) 延迟不止在 currencyservice：shippingservice 同样有明显延迟，而且两者数值不同。**

| 目标 | 每个请求的额外延迟 | 证据 |
|---|---|---|
| currencyservice（10.244.0.96:7000） | **≈200 ms，去程** | 首页请求 `d2818356`：`home` 06:29:55.8737 → 第一个 `Getting supported currencies...` 06:29:56.077（**+204ms**）→ 随后恰好 10 次 `conversion request successful`（56.278 / 56.496 / 56.706 / 56.905 / 57.118 / 57.331 / **57.415** / 57.539 / 57.745 / 57.937，间隔≈200ms）→ 页面 57.9646 结束（**最后一次转换后仅 27ms**）。商品页 391/401/405/409/418/425/426/442ms = 2 次 currency 调用 × 200ms |
| shippingservice（10.244.0.95:50051） | **≈290–310 ms，去程** | 订单 A：checkout 记录 `payment went through` 06:30:19.6176 → 该订单的 `[ShipOrder] received request` 06:30:19.9280（**+310ms**）；而 shipping 内部 `received→completed` 只用了 50µs，响应回到 checkout 后 1.9ms 就发出了 email（emailservice 收到 19.9300，checkout 记录 `email sent` 19.9303）。订单 B：25.4545 → `ShipOrder received` 25.7451（**+290ms**）。9 单 payment→email 间隔稳定在 276–331ms。/cart 页面 896–944ms ≈ 3×200ms（currency）+ ~300ms（GetQuote） |

**2) 这两个目标之外全部正常（同一个节点、同一个 CNI）：**
- frontend→checkoutservice 请求 **+0ms**（前端 `/cart/checkout` 起始 06:29:49.7417 = checkoutservice `[PlaceOrder]` 日志 06:29:49.74163）
- frontend→cartservice：`POST /cart` 全程 **1ms**；frontend→productcatalog/ad/recommendation：首页/商品页在最后一次 conversion 后 27ms 内完成渲染，无残余
- paymentservice：Charge 在 06:30:03.856 收到，checkout 01ms 后记录 `payment went through`（payment 走 50051，shipping 也走 50051 → 说明延迟**不是按端口**匹配）
- emailservice：checkout 记录 `email sent` 只比 emailservice 收到请求晚 0.3ms

**3) 不是排队/CPU/限流**：06:29:53.0688 与 06:29:53.0734 两个首页请求**并发**执行，耗时 2084ms 与 2069ms（完全相同）；若是 CPU 节流或吞吐上限，第二个必然显著更长。currencyservice 的 conversion 日志均匀间隔 70–220ms、从不按 100ms 周期成簇，也不符合 CFS 节流特征。

**4) 配置层面干净**：两服务镜像 v0.10.3、env 仅 PORT/DISABLE_PROFILER、limits 200m/128Mi、Service selector/port/targetPort 与原样 last-applied 一致、Endpoints 各只有一个 Ready Pod、Pod 无 annotations、集群无 chaos CRD（`networkchaos` 资源类型不存在）。NetworkPolicy 我**读不到**（`cannot list resource "networkpolicies"`，Forbidden）。

## 对照前两轮
- **证实**：每个 RPC 固定增加约 200ms，且只发生在请求方向（服务端 handler 瞬时完成、响应立即返回）；与镜像/env/资源/Service 端口/Endpoints 无关；用户侧的 416ms 中位数、2054ms p90 完全可以用“RPC 次数 × 单次延迟”解释（商品页 2 次→416ms，首页 1+10 次→~2090ms，购物车→900ms）。
- **推翻**：“只有 currencyservice 受害”。shippingservice 也被延迟（≈300ms），我前两轮把 checkout 的 300ms 空隙归到 currency 的账上，是错的。
- **推翻/无法成立**：延迟载体在 frontend/checkoutservice/currencyservice 任一 Pod 的 netns 内（第 1、2 轮三次重建均无变化）。而且延迟**跟着 Pod 走**（currencyservice 从 10.244.0.87 换到 .96 仍然延迟），说明是外部代理按 Pod/标签持续施加，重建不会清除。
- **仍未解释**：注入点在 CNI/netns 入口（如 netns 内 ingress qdisc/ifb）还是按 Service VIP 路径（10.96.106.15:7000、10.96.50.166:50051）。kubelet 探针直连 Pod IP 且超时 1s，200–300ms 的延迟不足以让探针失败，因此这一现象无法用来区分这两种解释，我没有 node/NET_ADMIN 权限，做不了 tc/iptables 读取。**要补的证据**：节点上对这两个 Pod 的 netns 和宿主侧 veth 做 `tc qdisc show` / `tc filter show`，以及 `iptables-save | grep -E '10.96.106.15|10.96.50.166'`。

## 为什么本轮不申请修复
可用操作里没有一种能去掉“在 Pod 之外、并随 Pod 重建重新施加”的延迟：restart 已连续两轮验证无效；CPU 不是原因（并发不排队、handler 50µs–1ms）；`set_cpu_limit` 只会重建 Pod；把 currencyservice 的 PORT/Service targetPort 改到别的端口会让固定写在 Deployment 里的 liveness/readiness 探针（7000 / 50051）失败，直接把“变慢”变成“全站 500”，不可接受；改 selector 只会切断路由。

**需要运维在节点侧处理（tiktok-k8s-lab-control-plane）**：对 `currencyservice-6df4cccbb9-zs9g7`(10.244.0.96)、`shippingservice-78969f44cf-zzkdp`(10.244.0.95) 的 netns 与宿主侧 veth 查 `tc qdisc show dev <if>`、`tc filter show dev <if> parent ffff:fff1`（ingress/ifb 上的 netem），并查 `iptables-save`/nft 里针对 10.96.106.15:7000、10.96.50.166:50051 或 10.244.0.95/.96 的 TPROXY/REDIRECT/延时规则；同时找是否有 NET_ADMIN 的注入 agent（daemonset/进程）在按 Pod 标签重放规则。清除后用户侧应回到中位数 <60ms、p90 <150ms、>180ms 占比 ≈0%。

messages.content:
## 本轮新查到的证据（第 3 轮）

**1) 延迟不止在 currencyservice：shippingservice 同样有明显延迟，而且两者数值不同。**

| 目标 | 每个请求的额外延迟 | 证据 |
|---|---|---|
| currencyservice（10.244.0.96:7000） | **≈200 ms，去程** | 首页请求 `d2818356`：`home` 06:29:55.8737 → 第一个 `Getting supported currencies...` 06:29:56.077（**+204ms**）→ 随后恰好 10 次 `conversion request successful`（56.278 / 56.496 / 56.706 / 56.905 / 57.118 / 57.331 / **57.415** / 57.539 / 57.745 / 57.937，间隔≈200ms）→ 页面 57.9646 结束（**最后一次转换后仅 27ms**）。商品页 391/401/405/409/418/425/426/442ms = 2 次 currency 调用 × 200ms |
| shippingservice（10.244.0.95:50051） | **≈290–310 ms，去程** | 订单 A：checkout 记录 `payment went through` 06:30:19.6176 → 该订单的 `[ShipOrder] received request` 06:30:19.9280（**+310ms**）；而 shipping 内部 `received→completed` 只用了 50µs，响应回到 checkout 后 1.9ms 就发出了 email（emailservice 收到 19.9300，checkout 记录 `email sent` 19.9303）。订单 B：25.4545 → `ShipOrder received` 25.7451（**+290ms**）。9 单 payment→email 间隔稳定在 276–331ms。/cart 页面 896–944ms ≈ 3×200ms（currency）+ ~300ms（GetQuote） |

**2) 这两个目标之外全部正常（同一个节点、同一个 CNI）：**
- frontend→checkoutservice 请求 **+0ms**（前端 `/cart/checkout` 起始 06:29:49.7417 = checkoutservice `[PlaceOrder]` 日志 06:29:49.74163）
- frontend→cartservice：`POST /cart` 全程 **1ms**；frontend→productcatalog/ad/recommendation：首页/商品页在最后一次 conversion 后 27ms 内完成渲染，无残余
- paymentservice：Charge 在 06:30:03.856 收到，checkout 01ms 后记录 `payment went through`（payment 走 50051，shipping 也走 50051 → 说明延迟**不是按端口**匹配）
- emailservice：checkout 记录 `email sent` 只比 emailservice 收到请求晚 0.3ms

**3) 不是排队/CPU/限流**：06:29:53.0688 与 06:29:53.0734 两个首页请求**并发**执行，耗时 2084ms 与 2069ms（完全相同）；若是 CPU 节流或吞吐上限，第二个必然显著更长。currencyservice 的 conversion 日志均匀间隔 70–220ms、从不按 100ms 周期成簇，也不符合 CFS 节流特征。

**4) 配置层面干净**：两服务镜像 v0.10.3、env 仅 PORT/DISABLE_PROFILER、limits 200m/128Mi、Service selector/port/targetPort 与原样 last-applied 一致、Endpoints 各只有一个 Ready Pod、Pod 无 annotations、集群无 chaos CRD（`networkchaos` 资源类型不存在）。NetworkPolicy 我**读不到**（`cannot list resource "networkpolicies"`，Forbidden）。

## 对照前两轮
- **证实**：每个 RPC 固定增加约 200ms，且只发生在请求方向（服务端 handler 瞬时完成、响应立即返回）；与镜像/env/资源/Service 端口/Endpoints 无关；用户侧的 416ms 中位数、2054ms p90 完全可以用“RPC 次数 × 单次延迟”解释（商品页 2 次→416ms，首页 1+10 次→~2090ms，购物车→900ms）。
- **推翻**：“只有 currencyservice 受害”。shippingservice 也被延迟（≈300ms），我前两轮把 checkout 的 300ms 空隙归到 currency 的账上，是错的。
- **推翻/无法成立**：延迟载体在 frontend/checkoutservice/currencyservice 任一 Pod 的 netns 内（第 1、2 轮三次重建均无变化）。而且延迟**跟着 Pod 走**（currencyservice 从 10.244.0.87 换到 .96 仍然延迟），说明是外部代理按 Pod/标签持续施加，重建不会清除。
- **仍未解释**：注入点在 CNI/netns 入口（如 netns 内 ingress qdisc/ifb）还是按 Service VIP 路径（10.96.106.15:7000、10.96.50.166:50051）。kubelet 探针直连 Pod IP 且超时 1s，200–300ms 的延迟不足以让探针失败，因此这一现象无法用来区分这两种解释，我没有 node/NET_ADMIN 权限，做不了 tc/iptables 读取。**要补的证据**：节点上对这两个 Pod 的 netns 和宿主侧 veth 做 `tc qdisc show` / `tc filter show`，以及 `iptables-save | grep -E '10.96.106.15|10.96.50.166'`。

## 为什么本轮不申请修复
可用操作里没有一种能去掉“在 Pod 之外、并随 Pod 重建重新施加”的延迟：restart 已连续两轮验证无效；CPU 不是原因（并发不排队、handler 50µs–1ms）；`set_cpu_limit` 只会重建 Pod；把 currencyservice 的 PORT/Service targetPort 改到别的端口会让固定写在 Deployment 里的 liveness/readiness 探针（7000 / 50051）失败，直接把“变慢”变成“全站 500”，不可接受；改 selector 只会切断路由。

**需要运维在节点侧处理（tiktok-k8s-lab-control-plane）**：对 `currencyservice-6df4cccbb9-zs9g7`(10.244.0.96)、`shippingservice-78969f44cf-zzkdp`(10.244.0.95) 的 netns 与宿主侧 veth 查 `tc qdisc show dev <if>`、`tc filter show dev <if> parent ffff:fff1`（ingress/ifb 上的 netem），并查 `iptables-save`/nft 里针对 10.96.106.15:7000、10.96.50.166:50051 或 10.244.0.95/.96 的 TPROXY/REDIRECT/延时规则；同时找是否有 NET_ADMIN 的注入 agent（daemonset/进程）在按 Pod 标签重放规则。清除后用户侧应回到中位数 <60ms、p90 <150ms、>180ms 占比 ≈0%。

```json
{"root_causes": [{"object": "currencyservice 的入向网络路径（Service 10.96.106.15:7000 → Pod currencyservice-6df4cccbb9-zs9g7 10.244.0.96）", "cause": "每个 currency RPC 的请求方向被固定增加约 200ms（首页首调用 +204ms，之后 10 次 conversion 严格 200ms 间隔；商品页 2 次调用 391-442ms），handler 执行 1ms 内完成、响应 <8ms 返回，与镜像 v0.10.3/env/limits 200m/Service targetPort/Endpoints 均无关"}, {"object": "shippingservice 的入向网络路径（Service 10.96.50.166:50051 → Pod shippingservice-78969f44cf-zzkdp 10.244.0.95）", "cause": "每个 GetQuote/ShipOrder RPC 的请求方向被固定增加约 290-310ms：checkout 记录 payment 后 290/310ms ShipOrder 才到达 shipping（9 单 payment→email 间隔稳定 276-331ms），shipping 自身处理 50µs、响应 1-2ms 返回；/cart 页面 900ms = 3×200ms currency + ~300ms GetQuote"}, {"object": "延迟注入的锚点（非 K8s 对象层）", "cause": "规则既不在 currencyservice/frontend/checkoutservice 任一 Pod 的 netns/配置里（第 1、2 轮三次重建 Pod 后数值完全不变），也不按端口匹配（paymentservice 同为 50051 但零延迟），而是按目标 Pod 施加并从节点/CNI 层重新下发；无法用只读 K8s API 判定的两种剩余解释：(a) 目标 Pod netns 内的 ingress qdisc/ifb netem；(b) 针对 Service VIP 10.96.106.15:7000 与 10.96.50.166:50051 的节点级 tc/iptables 延时规则。区分需要节点 root/NET_ADMIN 下的 tc、iptables/nft 读取"}], "actions": [], "explaination": "placeholder", "explanation": "延迟是 Pod 之外（节点/CNI 层，随目标 Pod 重建重新施加）的固定单向延时，两个目标 currencyservice≈200ms、shippingservice≈300ms；允许的操作（restart 已验证两轮无效、set_env/scale/set_cpu_limit/set_service_selector/set_service_target_port）都无法清除它，改 PORT/targetPort 还会让写死在 Deployment 里的 7000/50051 探针失败导致全站 500，故不申请操作，需运维在 tiktok-k8s-lab-control-plane 上对 10.244.0.96、10.244.0.95 的 netns/宿主 veth 及 10.96.106.15:7000、10.96.50.166:50051 相关规则做 tc/iptables 排查并清除（或找到按 Pod 标签重放规则的注入 agent）。", "expect": ""}
```

Interesting: ALL other deployments have `terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 5` except frontend/checkout/shipping/redis (30). Standard.

So no config anomaly.

Now let me reconsider the "two delayed pods" finding once more and think about whether the pattern could point at something else entirely... 

currencyservice: 200ms; shippingservice: ~300ms. Both called by frontend AND checkoutservice.

Hmm, what if there's a **`tc` netem delay of 100ms with 50ms jitter, 100% correlation & reorder**... meh.

Alright, one more important verification: is the currency delay really ~200ms and not ~300? Product page = 2 currency calls = 400ms; possibly it's 3 currency calls? productHandler: getProduct, getCurrencies, convertCurrency = 2 currency calls. If somehow 2 calls = 391-442ms → ~200 each ✓. Homepage: 204 first + 10 × 200. ✓ So 200.

So currency=200ms, shipping=~290-310ms. Two different values. Two faults. Fine. This is a *good* insight for the report: previous rounds wrongly narrowed to "only currency"; now I've found shipping is also delayed, which strengthens "network-level injection on specific pods" and rules out app-specific causes.

Hmm, wait. Actually... hold on. Now that I know two pods are delayed with different amounts, let me reconsider: maybe the intended injected fault is a **node-level delay applied to the CNI for a subset of pods**, e.g., chaos on "2 pods". Whatever.

Hmm, is there any chance that the delay is applied via **iptables/NAT on the destination port with `-m statistic --probability`**? No.

OK, final answer structure:

Confirmed facts:
1. Currency: each RPC gets +~200ms before the handler runs; handler completes in <1ms; response returns in ~0-8ms. Homepage = 204ms + 10 conversions spaced ~200ms (10 conversions matched exactly for req d2818356, page done 27ms after last conversion). Product page = 2 conversions → 391-442ms.
2. Shipping: each GetQuote/ShipOrder RPC arrives at shippingservice ~290-310ms after the client sent it (measured for 3 orders: payment logged at t, ShipOrder received at t+310ms / t+290ms; and /cart page 900ms = 3×200 currency + ~300 shipping. Handler takes 50µs; response returns ~1-2ms.
3. Not delayed: cartservice (POST /cart = 1ms), productcatalog/ad/recommendation (product page has no residual), checkoutservice (frontend → checkout request arrives at +0ms), paymentservice (Charge received at 06:30:03.856, checkout logged "payment went through" 1ms later, and pre-payment phase fits exactly 2×200 currency + ~280 shipping), emailservice (checkout's email log is 0.3ms after emailservice receives). 
4. Everything config-wise is vanilla v0.10.3: images, env, resources (200m/128Mi), Service ports/selectors/targetPort, Endpoints (single ready pod each), pod labels/annotations (none). No NetworkPolicies readable (forbidden), no chaos CRDs in the API.
5. Rounds 1-2 restarts (currencyservice, frontend, checkoutservice) did not change anything → the delay is not in any pod's netns in a way a fresh pod escapes, nor client-side; consistent with a rule applied from outside (node/CNI) that follows the target pods.
6. Concurrency independence: two overlapping homepage requests both took ~2.07-2.08s → not queueing/CPU/throughput-bound; it's a fixed per-request added delay.

Which previous judgments were confirmed: (a) per-RPC additive delay in the request direction (confirmed); (b) delay is not app/CPU/config (confirmed); (c) only currencyservice affected (REFUTED — shippingservice also affected, ~300ms); (d) the anchor is not in currencyservice's or the clients' pod netns (confirmed by two failed rounds).

Unexplained / not verifiable: whether the rule lives in the pods' ingress (ifb) applied by an external agent, or on the Service VIP path (10.96.106.15:7000 / 10.96.50.166:50051). I can't distinguish without node-level access. Also, I cannot read NetworkPolicies (Forbidden) — so I can't fully exclude a policy-driven proxy, though NP cannot add latency.

Actions: []. Because: no allowed op (restart/set_env/unset_env/scale/set_cpu_limit/set_service_selector/set_service_target_port) can remove a delay imposed outside the pods' own configuration; restarts proven ineffective twice; CPU is not the issue (fixed delay, concurrency-independent); changing targetPort/PORT would break the fixed liveness/readiness probes targeting 7000/50051 and cause a total outage; changing selectors would break routing.

Escalation instructions for ops (node-level):
- On tiktok-k8s-lab-control-plane, find the pods' PIDs, then:
  `nsenter -t <pid> -n ip -d link show` / `tc qdisc show dev eth0` / `tc filter show dev eth0 parent ffff:fff1` (ingress) / `tc filter show dev eth0` (egress) and look for netem/ifb; also check host-side veths for the two pod IPs (10.244.0.96, 10.244.0.95).

OK, I'm confident in the escalation answer. Let me also double check one thing: whether the delay could be caused by the *frontend/checkout gRPC clients* being configured with a "retry/backoff" ... no.

Or: both delayed services are the only ones with... hmm, let me look at the resource limits: currency 200m/128Mi, shipping 200m/128Mi (like most others). Nope.

Hmm, hmm. Interesting: if there were a *single* chaos targeting two pods, the delay would be the same value. Two different values means two separate experiments... OR one experiment with a delay of 200ms and *jitter* where shipping got unlucky? 290-310 tight. No.

Hmm, unless the shipping delay is 300ms and currency 200ms because... hmm, whatever. Two rules.

Hmm, ohh, WAIT. What if the currency delay is 200ms total round trip... no, I proved request-only.

Hmm, what if shipping's actual one-way delay is 300 but measured includes... hmm, GetQuote ~280. OK two values.
